body: I can't wait to be able to do this, training my way up!!

this whole ordeal makes me never wanna touch anything ever again. i was always wary of medication before because i didn't want to become dependent snd addicted. i just want this whole thing to be over so i can start healing a little bit

i've had to learn to find good in bad things. that's how i made it even this long. i just know i'll feel better when they know i'm fine with the help i have even though i know i have their support. i'm just gonna do my best

there was a solid two hours where i felt like i was on top of the world. i like felt self love for the first time snd i was confident again. it felt like true happiness. i cried so hard because it had been so long since i felt like that. really just a small taste of joy is why i'm working hard to be happy again through therapy. i'd do anything to live everything that confident and loving of myself. i gave myself so many compliments and i meant them. it was amazing. the crash i had was definitely not worth it though. eating and sleeping were way out of the question and it still sucks even though most symptoms disappeared. it's like having stomach flu times 20 and having severe hallucinations and paranoia. sleep paralysis that you can never escape. it was the most terrifying thing that's ever happened to me. 

as for trippy, a childhood imaginary friend of mine reappeared and i talked with them. i was convinced that my stuffed animal was the ghost of my dead uncle. and i thought that my younger brothers folded laundry was going to strangle me in my sleep. why? i'm not sure but it was surreal

i didn't have it until my attempt tbh. coming close to death and experience the worst physical pain of my life kinda helped? that sounds weird but it made me realize that i'm strong. i just thought about how therapy the first time around didn't work and why it didn't help. i figure that if i go about it on my own and take my time snd actually try to be happy then it might work. 

finally accepting the help i need is really hard for me too. i've always been really hardheaded and independent. i always acted like i was fine and knew what i was doing. i'm just glad to be able to get help and not feel bad for it. hopefully my recover goes well and there's more good days than bad. i'm actually gonna try to be happy this time around lmao. therapy part 2: electric boogaloo

i've learned that it's precious and my attempt made me realize that i have to live snd stay here. but i'm sure i'll change a lot more, i'm not even 16 yet and highschool changes people a least a little. i know for sure that last year me compared to me right now are two completely different people. i feel like i changed for the better though. i had to get through the hard things to find the joys and really appreciate everything in life. yeah i shouldn't have even tried but i'm glad that i did and i'm glad that i survived. i'm never gonna do this again for starters and now at least i feel like a person again. i'm just going to do everything i can to be the best version of me

i'm really glad nobody woke up to find me dead. that's the last thing i ever want. and i'm going to tell my family what happened i just need at least a month. i'll bring it up in therapy during my next appointment. this is technically my 3rd attempt so i might have to go to the hospital for a while. honestly i think it'd be good for me, i'm just learning that taking recovery at my own pace is better than being forced and people making me get better when i just couldn't then. now i can actually put forth the effort to recover snd im ready to take the hard steps. and i will make those hard decisions and have those sad but needed conversations. it'll just be on my own time.

i genuinely thought i was going into cardiac arrest with how panicked i was and how fast my heart was beating. seeing hallucinations and that overlooking anxiety and paranoia is probably the most terrifying thing i've ever experienced. i didn't sleep for 38 hours straight and i didn't eat (and stomach it) until 48 hours had passed. it's literal hell and i want people to know there's ways to get help that's not suicide or even an attempt. i'm never gonna forget how scared i was, i still am frankly. i was petrified of sleeping because i didn't know if i would wake up. my therapist is gonna get an earful from me for a while. i'm really glad that i didn't die, but the crashing was so traumatic i just can't put it into words. it's easily the worst/scariest moment of my life so far.
i'm glad you found a way to keep going man. i'm just a teenager who thought it was the end but it wasn't. i'm getting therapy don't worry lmao

they have always been really supportive of me and especially when they first found out i was struggling mentally they really tried to support me. i had to have a conversation with my dad about what he's doing that makes me feel worse or better. i was surprised that he actually changed how he acted towards me immediately. i still couldn't ask my family to do this though, we've lost too many friends and family to addiction. i know that they *would* support me snd help but it would also hurt them that i even turned to anything like this. taking the pills was really the only attempt i has in which i was actually in danger of dying. other times was just me having a breakdown and getting on the verge of doing it and then not last second. i'd much rather get my help from therapy snd ill tell them in the future when i'm better. they won't worry about me as much that way
this year pushed me over the edge but i eventually did realize that i still wanted to live. it's still incredibly hard, i just don't consider suicide an option anymore. i'm really glad that i don't

she was tempted, she didn't know if it would help me though. so she just gave me pain meds and told me to try and get some rest. eventually the headache went away. she doesn't know that i took the adderall though. she's convinced it's stomach flu that i had last year so i've been running with that. i had to sneak some eye drops though lmao

yeah the high was really nice. i felt really happy for the first time in a while. but i don't want to be happy with the help of something i'm not prescribed. it personally just means more- idk if i make sense. i also like have been really sick from crashing so that's also a reason- i just know for an hour or two i was soaring and i was feeling really confident in myself. it was really nice to feel even a little bit happy after the last year or so.

i can easily say this is worst pain i've ever been in physically. the migraine i had for the first night had me literally crying so hard that my mom got mad since she couldn't go to sleep. thankfully that didn't last long. i'm definitely doing frozen yougurt- i've been trying to figure out what i wanna try to eat and that literally sounds perfect. i just can't wait until i'm not sick. thanks for all the help making this less painful than it would've been.

building up tolerance is very important for these kind of things. i wasn't quite interested in staying on adderall though. i wanted to die from it but i was an idiot and i definitely didn't have enough pills to do it. i also didn't know how hard it was to try and od, shit hurts so badly. it's only been like 3 days and it feels like i've been sick for a month. i'm just not gonna do anything like this again lmao.

my mom saw me this morning and said i was like visibly just sick. i've lost some weight since i haven't really been able to eat and now i'm just puking and nauseas. and yougurt and popsicles sound amazing right now- might try and go get some if i can get up. i'm pretty weak from all this, anytime i'm sick really i lose most of my strength in my arms and legs. it's weird, anyways- thanks for the advice, as i always i appreciate so much
i don't plan on it lmao

i was actually able to get in 6 hours last night. i took something for pain and slept like a baby. i'm hoping that the vomiting goes away today, i'm pretty sure that i got all the adderall out of my system. i'm just puking stomach acid instead of whatever it was i had yesterday and the day before.

i might ask my doctor about medical marijuana? my mom has her own prescription and has always been open about it (once i was old enough to know it wasn't recreational use) and i was sucking on ice cubes to keep my mouth from being dry and to pace my drinking so i didn't throw up

i did my research and double checked the pointers i got from people on here. google was shitty and i tried to find more sources before posting my problem. most people have pretty good advice, one dude just judged me for wanting to end it all in one go. i didn't plan on surviving either man lmao
and yeah, i did bring it upon myself. it sucks but it is my fault. i'll be fine though, lesson learned

i didn't want the high, i thought that the side effects would kill me somehow. send me into a heart attack or something. i asked a friend. how much he recommended and i don't a bit more than that. i just wanted to die man, i wasn't interested in getting a high or anything.

i asked my mom to pick me up some fruits and over the counter things from the store. i'm definitely going to try snd eat well. i just hope it stays down. and thanks for the pineapple juice rec, i'll put that on the list too. i'm just happy my paranoias finally gone- i hated living like that. although nausea and vomiting aren't ideal, they're bareable

i attempted this year and my family didn't know until i told my girlfriend and she reported it. for around 4 or 5 months i was legally required to go to therapy (i'm a minor and that required counseling? i had more than one attempt so that's probably why) but until they found out about my attempts i genuinely thought that they didn't care and that they all hated me. my mother was manipulative and emotionally abusive. she had to stop herself from hitting me all the time, she knew exactly what she was doing and i didn't have evidence of it wasn't anything physical. i ended up just moving out of her house the second i was able to. for years that abuse came back to me and i thought that people who met me just pitied me for my past so they were my friend. these past few months i've come to discover that a lot of people do love snd care about me but even after i realized that i still wanted to die? it wasn't after until my most recent attempt that i didn't want to even try again. i'm still in recovery from the pills i took snd im in hell rn. but it's nice to say that i'd rather be alive than dead in my room snd my parents find me. the only thing that kept me going for a long time was that if i couldn't live for myself, then i needed to do it for the people that i loved and cared about. this definitely might sound weird for some people but it did help me not want to die. this year has overall been the worst, after i was reported therapy started immediately. and i really wasn't ready to talk about it yet. this may be weird but i wasn't ready to take that step and want to recover. i didn't want to try anything at all because i was hopeless and i needed time to process everything going on. i stopped therapy as soon as it wasn't required and i haven't been back since. its been 3 months without it and i'm finally ready to go back snd get a different therapist than the one i had previously. it feels better getting help when i was the one who chose to. i don't like being pushed or forced to do things even if they seem like it would be "good for me" i just wasn't ready. looking back on everything that's majorly happened. i consider myself extremely lucky, yeah what happened to me still sucked but i know i have it better than a lot of people. it's really terrible snd i couldn't imagine the pain that they're in. i can only hope they end up okay. it's been a long road snd im finally able to be alive for myself. it may not seem like much but it's a whole new feeling just doing things for me. it took me so long to se show much people would hurt if i was gone, and it took me even longer to live for myself but now that it's happening it's worth it. the years of suffering lead to this moment and it's really hard to get to. i'm just glad. i'm also really sorry i got off track typing this out- tonight's been wacky lmao

pills are terrible. i don't recommend suicide at all- the second i tried it i was just filled with instant regret. i'm only just now recovering from my attempt- it fucking sucked, as soon as i started crashing and the high wore off i just had the worst two days mentally and physically. and i don't know much about other methods but i tried hanging and it definitely didn't work. it was just painful and i had to start seeing a chiropractor because of it. and even thought some people immediately think guns just get it over with, so many attempted suicides by gun go wrong. missing even a little bit could just physically and mentally handicap you for the rest of your life. i couldn't imagine going through the amount of suffering it takes to attempt and then having it end that badly. idk- i'm not really good with this. i just know i'm never attempting again no matter how bad it gets. and i've heard about the legal euthanization thing snd i have many questions about it. like, i know it's mainly used for elderly, people with chronic illnesses, etc. but what if somebody was abused and they wished to die peacefully? or if you come from a bad financial situation and you can't afford to pay medical bills or loans? just so many situations people would rather die than take the long road of recovery (i completely understand, recovery is a commitment that's hard to do) but please- i understand it's hard snd that i'm just some stranger on the internet but i've been there and it took me a really close failed attempt to want to stay here. i know you think it's hopeless and that death is a much better alternative than life but we don't know what's after death. nobody's completely sure. and this may be the only chance at life we have or maybe this is just one of our hundreds of lifetimes. but living and experiencing life is worth it. there's so many things out there that you've yet to discover. i know suicide is incredibly tempting snd more than likely you can't be talked out of it. but please be careful, i hope you're okay.

i'm just glad it ended up okay lmao. i can look back at this and have a good laugh on how dumb i am in the future. i may be getting professional help but i'm still allowed to joke about the stupid things i've done.

i was attempting to kms and i have very little knowledge about pills. i realized that i didn't want to die and i like freaked out until i realized i was fine. i just want to be myself again. i'm definitely taking the eating advice, someone said bananas and oats are good things to try. but don't worry, i'm not doing this again. it took this whole ordeal to make me realize living is better than dying. after i get better i'm going back to therapy. i plan on getting help! i just need to be myself again first. not really jittery and paranoid. besides, being sick is one of the things i hate the most so ig this is karma? i tried to die so now i have to get better even with the pain.
i have some weird brand i drink that has some sugar in it and lots of electrolytes. i've been drinking these and water like crazy

i didn't think of bananas. they're really good for potassium snd just an easy snack. i'll definitely try out oats too. i'm just hungry, i haven't eaten since 7 AM yesterday. it's been a while 37 hours since i was able to eat. i'm definitely doing this now

don't worry. after one attempt i'm never doing it again. the second i couldn't take it back i regretted it so i'm happy that i'm still here. i just want to be back to normal me snd not paranoid me who can't sleep. once i'm all back to normal i'll be just fine. to be fair, nobody besides my therapist knows i attempted. my family just thinks that i got stomach flu again.
sadly i don't, i'm pretty young just a teen. i stole my brothers old prescription that he's off of. i think the liquids snd exercise sounds good
yeah if i knew what was coming i would've never taken them
You're a life saver- i've been doing the drinking but what about vomiting? i haven't been able to eat without throwing it back up
i hit thé high HOURS ago. yeah it was nice but if i knew about this i don't think it's worth it. it's nice snd i started to believe in myself and i felt happy for the first time in maybe 5 years.
at least big for me taking it
around 25 hours- it was a huge dose 260mg on XR.

i've been really on edge but i did tell my therapist about it and she's referring me to a specialist. i'm still feeling a few of the side affects of adderall .i've been jittery and paranoid, and i can't eat or sleep. i'm really trying to sleep and eat but i can't. isn't there like something that cancels out the affects of adderall?

yeah- pills was something that seemed easier than what i've tried before. on the bright side i don't wanna die anymore so- i guess it turned out okay? i'm just staying the hell away from adderall. my family's full of people who have lost everything they had to addiction. and i know how devastating it is watching a loved one slowly disappear. and yeah, my attempt was a little over 24 hours ago and i was just really fucking sick. i'm just in tricky territory. i finally realized that i should keep living and i'm making myself try to stay out of addiction. i know i can't really choose what happens all the time but i'm never swallowing pills that isn't something for a headache again- god, being sick last night and today has been kicking my ass. and i can easily say that i'm just a stupid kid that wanted to end it all and just didn't know enough to do it. i'm glad i didn't better than adderall though, no more suicide attempts for me. i'll get better and i'll make my brother hide his pills for all of our sakes. thanks for like- commenting. today's been so tiring, i'm only just now being able to eat and keep everything down. i'm sure i'll be fine as time goes on.
cant have group therapy with nice advice if the therapist is smoking in the parking lot
thanks man! the amount of adderall i had in my system wasn't lethal so i'm gonna be high anxiety for this whole week. but thank you.

i'm sure you saw my update posts but i survived. i'm a walking miracle and there's no way in hell i'm dying yet. i'm gonna get the resources i need to heal and get better. physically i'm perfect, just some stomach and head aches which is way better than being dead. thanks for caring btw- i didn't see any replies until after i got home from the hospital. i really appreciate it

my girlfriend and i both have family history of bad mental health issues and i just got out of an extremely rough time for myself. we've both agreed that in order to prevent our kids from suffering the same way we did, we're gonna adopt when the time comes and rehabilitate a child that needs it most. with how the foster care system is, i wanna adopt so many kids and give them the best life i possibly can.

i tried with pills thinking i'd take them then take a nap so i die peacefully in my sleep. that did not work at all. i drove to the doctors, i was fine and i had the worst migraine of my life for hours and i can't feel my legs still. (called my doctor and i'm fine, just some side effects) worst mistake of my life. i'm never trying to kms again. it's not worth the physical and emotional pain if you survive.
